evidence.detail: R87 GpuRenderer constructs rs/k/i as a separate sibling to R89 SceneUploader and invokes it directly for model-to-GPU staging, so the class is not the already-identified SceneUploader.

The class accepts the exact-v308 Model type plus GpuIntBuffer/GpuFloatBuffer staging objects, enforces the 6144-face cap, writes packed model vertex/color/UV data and exposes the same HSL override interpolation primitive used by the public GPU/HD model pushers.
The surrounding rs/k/b/* classes are independently identified as the 117 HD BufferPool/ModelCache/ModelHasher/TempModelInfo lineage, placing rs/k/i in the same model-upload architecture.

117 HD source preserves a dedicated class named ModelPusher that is owned separately from SceneUploader and is responsible for converting Model data into GpuIntBuffer/GpuFloatBuffer staging data; older RuneLite revisions show the same pushModel logic before it was split out of SceneUploader.

proposals.note: ModelPusher is supported by exact-v308 separate renderer ownership, model-staging behavior, and the independently recovered 117 HD model-cache family. Exact v308 remains the semantic authority.
